findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "x402_stats" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Fivebar's index of x402 payments (USDG transferWithAuthorization) on Robinhood Chain: the last 24 hours and recent days, screened before they count. Volume that…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stocks_list · Private data: stocks_list, stock_quote, token_quote, swap_quote, token_risk, swap_build, wallet_holdings, agent_lookup, check_seller · Public sink: swap_build · Destructive: wallet_holdings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stocks_list · Private data: stocks_list, stock_quote, token_quote, swap_quote, token_risk, swap_build, wallet_holdings, agent_lookup, check_seller · Public sink: swap_build · Destructive: wallet_holdings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
